title: The three actual base-change squares
statement: For any morphism g:Yprime→Y of schemes, the maps baseP and baseW in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-source-pullback] satisfy BaseSquares g: they commute with the diagonal immersion and with each product projection. No flatness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: The two product projection equations are the defining equations of pullback.map. Compose the diagonal equation with both product projections; the defining equations of the two diagonals make the composites equal, so pullback hom extensionality proves the equation.

mathlib_searches.query: A cone of root projections followed by free module units induces a map into the inverse limit of integral Tate twists. Coefficient quotient by a regular element commutes with geometric pullback and direct image.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the ordinary limit universal property and the existing free-module adjunction.
